title: Senior Staff Accountant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Staff Accountant. Key Responsibilities:
- Manage full-cycle accounting, including general ledger, AP, and AR.
- Prepare and review month-end and year-end financial statements.
- Ensure compliance with GAAP and internal accounting policies.
- Assist with external audits and tax preparation.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
- CPA certification is highly preferred.
- Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, SAP).
- Strong analytical and organizational skills.
